تعليمات إزالة التغليف وإعادة التعبئة

Remove packing nuts (19A and 19B-see fig A, pg. 7) 
ملحوظة: some pumps have a lock screw to secure the packing nut once it
 has been adjusted

Use a packing pick to remove the old packing. Care must be used not
 to scratch or damage the shaft in the packing area while removing and
 installing packing
Inspect the packing gland area. Be sure it is clean

items:

ملحوظة: some pumps have a lock screw to secure the packing nut once it

sections.text:
Select the desired packing. See step # 2 (A) above. Pre-formed
 packing will seat in more quickly

Lubricate your packing rigs with "Triflon" or use a good grade of machine 
 oil if "Triflon" is not available

Insert the packing rings. 
ملحوظة : rotate each new packing ring so the split is 90 degrees away from the 
 last split. A small screw driver can be used to press the packings into the 
 gland area. Be careful not to damage or scratch the shaft

Leave approximately 1/4 of threads clear of the last packing so that the 
 adjusting nut (19 A and 19B) can be started

Tighten the packing adjusting nuts (19 A and 19 B) a little more than 
 "finger tight"

تشديد العبوات 
 حتى يتم إبطاء التسرب إلى تيار صغير عند كل منهما 
 التعبئة. اترك المضخة تعمل لمدة ساعتين تقريبًا لبدء عملية الضخ 
 عملية الجلوس. ملحوظة : 
 if the packings are over tightened so that no leakage occurs, the packing 
 will burn and score the shaft. Always allow a little pump age to weep through 
 the packing to insure cooling.

بعد ساعتين من أ 
 قد يحدث تسرب سريع للسائل من خلال العبوة 
 أعد تشديد العبوة إلى التنقيط البطيء. السماح لمدة 15 دقيقة على الأقل ل 
 عبوات لتشكيل العمود في منطقة التعبئة.

Any further packing 
 adjustment must be done with extreme care. Tighten 
 the packing nut 1/8 turn, then immediately loosen the packing nut 
 1/16 turn. Are the packings still weeping a little moisture? (They should 
 be). Allow the pump to run several hours at this setting

For any subsequent 
 packing adjustment, follow step 6c above and be aware 
 of the burn comment made in step 6a
